subsubthemes.name: Training agents to use tools better through rewards
subsubthemes.gist: Teaching AI agents to interact with software and websites by rewarding successful actions and learning from failures without manual instructions.

subsubthemes.name: Building agents that work together
subsubthemes.gist: Creating multi-agent systems where several AI agents collaborate, compete, or learn from each other to solve complex tasks.

subsubthemes.name: Teaching agents to reason step by step
subsubthemes.gist: Improving how agents think through problems by learning to break tasks into smaller steps and check their own work as they go.

subsubthemes.name: Agents that learn from their own experience
subsubthemes.gist: Letting agents improve by replaying what happened before, updating their understanding of the world, and trying new strategies based on past mistakes.

subsubthemes.name: Testing and improving agents without human help
subsubthemes.gist: Finding ways to automatically create better training examples and improve agent performance by having agents test themselves.

subsubthemes.name: Controlling agents to navigate user interfaces
subsubthemes.gist: Training computer-use agents to understand and act on graphical interfaces by learning from success and failure when interacting with screens.

subsubthemes.name: Combining language models with learning
subsubthemes.gist: Teaching large language models to improve through reinforcement learning and to use external tools and knowledge during reasoning.
